description: Strict drift-detection bounds for successor runs compared with the accepted Phase 4 refactor science snapshot.
rationale: The accepted refactor snapshot is now the predecessor, so the broader historical OG/refactor filtered-map allowance does not apply.
All map products must remain many orders of magnitude below scientifically relevant changes during behavior-preserving work.
Discrete flags, counts, identifiers, and classifications must remain exact.
An intentional scientific change requires a successor validation epoch rather than a wider threshold in this profile.
